description: Returns the profile of a cruise ship: cruise line, year built, size, passengers, crew and the consulting description. Use it when the user asks what a ship is like or wants to compare ships. It does NOT return deck plans, cabin numbers, live prices or availability.

handle.description: Consultation handle returned by a previous call (structuredContent.handle). Pass it on every call so wishes are remembered; omit it on the very first call.

language.description: Language of the answer. Defaults to the provider's language.

name: ship_profile
title: Ship profile
